text: Our paper was approved by both reviewers. The second reviewer identified four areas where our manuscript could be strengthened by incorporating additional insights and clarifying certain points. We carefully considered the reviewer's suggestions and have revised our paper accordingly. Specific revisions include: 1. Addressing requests for non-citation of specific authors: We have addressed any requests to avoid citing certain authors due to reputational concerns or previous behavior. 2. Incorporating reviewer acknowledgements: We have included a section in the acknowledgements to formally recognize the valuable contributions of the reviewers. 3. Highlighting the issue of plagiarism: We have emphasized the importance of avoiding plagiarism of reviewers' comments and ensured that all feedback is integrated into the manuscript in authors' own words. 4. Reducing redundancies and repetition: We have carefully reviewed the manuscript for redundancies and repetition, making necessary revisions to improve clarity and conciseness. In addition to these revisions, we have: 1. Added three new references to support our arguments. 2. Improved Table 1 to enhance its clarity and relevance. 3. Acknowledged the reviewers in the acknowledgements section. We believe that these revisions have significantly strengthened our manuscript and addressed the reviewer's comments effectively.
